refreshing.title: Updating
refreshing.body: Showing what was loaded before while the page updates.

emptyNew.title: Nothing here yet
emptyNew.body: When there is something to show, it will appear here.

emptyFiltered.title: No matches for these criteria
emptyFiltered.body: {count, plural, one {# filter is} other {# filters are}} active. Change or remove a filter to see more.

partial.title: Some sections could not load
partial.body: The rest of the page is up to date. Try the missing sections again.

stale.title: This may be out of date

permissionLimited.title: You don't have access to this
permissionLimited.body: Ask the person who manages it to give you access.

sessionExpired.title: Your session has ended
sessionExpired.body: Sign in again to continue. Nothing was sent on your behalf.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Changes you make now stay on this device and are not sent until you reconnect.

slow.title: This is taking longer than usual
slow.body: We're still working on it. You can wait here or check again later.

validationError.title: {count, plural, one {# field needs} other {# fields need}} attention
validationError.body: Correct the marked fields. Everything else you entered is kept.

unknownOutcome.title: We're checking whether this completed
unknownOutcome.body: Don't send it again yet. Reference: {reference}.

versionConflict.title: Someone else changed this
versionConflict.body: Your version is kept. Review the latest changes before applying yours.

dirtyDraft.title: Unsaved changes
dirtyDraft.body: Your changes are not saved yet.

revoked.title: No longer available
revoked.body: Access was removed or the item was deleted.

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
rateLimited.body: Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. What you entered is kept.

unsupported.title: Not available here
unsupported.body: This isn't offered here. Call the team and we'll help another way.
